pre_freeze_corrections.observation: A single-bit length increase within cap can leave a valid-looking incomplete frame rather than immediate feed error.
pre_freeze_corrections.resolution: Corruption test checks EOF rejection as well as zero packet callbacks; protocol explicitly requires caller partial-frame deadline.

pre_freeze_corrections.observation: Initial -I multi-file Python test lacked its own source-directory import path.
pre_freeze_corrections.resolution: Backend/tests explicitly add only their resolved own source directory, not cwd.

pre_freeze_corrections.observation: Actual SIGTERM test found selectors swallowed InterruptedError raised by the handler.
pre_freeze_corrections.resolution: Final handler sets a sticky signal flag; next <=50ms loop fails and cleanup cannot itself be interrupted by repeated signals. Final actual SIGTERM test passes.
Multi-file scripts set sys.dont_write_bytecode before local imports; accidental pre-handoff bytecode caches removed/excluded before final source freeze.
